name: After § 23
title: REPORT on Parliament’s estimates of revenue and expenditure for the financial year 2026
part_text: 23a. Rejects the financing of the budget line for capacity-building programmes for third-country parliaments, the programme for young political leaders from third countries, and the invitations of opinion multipliers from third countries; considers this to be an unjustified interference and an unnecessary expenditure that does not fall within Parliament’s mandate; stresses that public funds are being used for ideological activities with very limited added value, while Union citizens expect a rigorous and responsible management of budgetary resources; recalls that Parliament should focus on its core legislative activities rather than funding programmes that have no tangible impact on Union citizens;
